item.title: Rust SIMD After Eight Years: Fearless SIMD v1.0 Ships — Officially '0 unsafe', I Grepped 50 Blocks
item.description: linebender promoted its 2018 prototype to fearless_simd 1.0.0: portable SIMD without thousands of hand-written unsafe blocks. But the official post claims 'no ad-hoc unsafe in this crate' — I pulled the 1.0.0 source from crates.io and grepped out 50. Not a contradiction: 'block count' and 'audit surface' are different instruments. The control crate wide 1.7.1 comes out at 441.
